description: A pump.fun deployer's record by wallet address, no coin needed: launches, graduations, best run, the gap between launches; over the last 90 days how many of its launches doubled, did 10x, held at 2x a day later or died; its newest launches; and the base rate for its next launch from deployers with the same record. Facts, no score. $0.005 a call, USDC on Solana over x402.

payment.description: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for this exact call (USDC on Solana). Leave it out to get the offer: the price, the payee and the network come back as the error content and as _meta['payment-required'].

name: deployer_record
